text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is an entertainment sport where Umamusume
showcase overwhelming running prowess
and wage fierce battles on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Twinkle Series began in Japan,
the racetracks have always been—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Excitement, deep emotion, joy...
And the deafening cheers—the air was filled with it all.
choice_data_list: The Twinkle Series is the best!
The Twinkle Series is the best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>, whom I've signed a contract with,
is finally making her debut in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, there was just one—lingering concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That is—
choice_data_list: (It feels like there are “again” fewer people…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A graded stakes race is taking place at Tokyo Racecourse today—
With such a high-profile race, it ought to be packed with spectators.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet even right before the main race, the fervor didn't feel as intense as before... My concern hardened into certainty—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: —Lately, I feel like the number of fan letters my trainee Umamusume gets has been decreasing...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I asked an acquaintance at the URA,
and sure enough, overall attendance numbers are down.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I feel like it hasn't really been
trending on social media as much lately.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Until not long ago, my feed would be flooded
with related trending words right after a race, but now..."

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Maybe the racing craze has just calmed down...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well, this has happened a few times before.
I'm sure everyone will come back again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> will make her debut *now*.
Just drifting along with the flow of time...
won't get her there in time.
choice_data_list: (If I don't hype everyone up now, there's no point!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—For <chrname>, who has made her dream come true,
nothing could be more fitting than to be welcomed
by a packed, roaring stadium.
choice_data_list: (We're going to change it—with our own hands!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had no plan whatsoever. Even so, driven solely by the urge to do something, I rushed over to Chairwoman Akikawa—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Long-awaited!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
We've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>'s
concerns are completely justified! But—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You are not the only one...
sensing the crisis and moving to act!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume themselves
are also thinking about this... as the ones directly involved!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Gaining knowledge by probing the nature of things... first, the essence...
I need to understand what fans seek from the Twinkle Series and why they cheer for us.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Using that as our foundation, concrete measures—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"What the audience wants to see
is already set in stone."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a race.
As long as the race is interesting, I have no complaints.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you have a point.
If so, what should we consider next?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...She'll put on an interesting race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. However, that alone is insufficient.
We must simultaneously consider the means to deliver that race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then let's proceed with the discussion in that direction.
What other appeals does the Twinkle Series offer?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—I knew it!
It's having a super-duper Umadol around, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A shining star steals everyone's hearts!
Everyone should just become an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. An Umamusume with idol-like popularity brings fans to the racetrack too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Higher attendance boosts the overall excitement...
which in turn makes the races themselves more thrilling, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A proposal to enhance idol appeal in that sense... I see. Truly impressive, Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Right?☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Time to kick off the Super Umadol Project!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone involved in the Twinkle Series!
Unite as one and overcome this crisis!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, let's go!
—They're waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I told you, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone connected to the Twinkle Series,
unite as one—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: To escape from this crisis!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's going on, do you think?
Calling a sudden meeting like this...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Huh...?
Is someone up on the roof?
—Everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
……Hm? Wait…… A-Aaah!
Isn't that over there……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A stir echoed across the entire academy—
Looking up, the one standing there was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They were the 'Legend Umamusume'...
who carved their brilliant hoofprints into history!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Helllooo, everyone!
Hi there, I'm Haiseiko!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Hello, darlings.
I am St Lite.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
My dear Umamusume!
Speed Symboli here.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, first and foremost,
there is something I wish to impart to you all.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume possess
infinite potential!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"In racing,
there is supreme joy!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is magnificent.
In which case, there is only one thing to do—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We must draw attention.
So, allow us to—make a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Here and now!
I declare the opening of the 'Dream Fest'!
